    4000 resamples, seed 0, percentile intervals, K = 8.
    THE UNIT IS THE ROUTE, not the frame. The split is made at route level and frames within a route are strongly correlated, so a frame-level interval understates the uncertainty. Both are reported so the gap between them is visible.
    Scores are the Mahalanobis distance to the nearest GMM component unless stated otherwise.

Are the margins between the attention distances real?
